scope: Offline original 1.50.10 NOR audit only; no device access, no firmware writes, no credential output.

persistent_task_takeover.entry_abi: int main(int argc, char **argv); normal scheduled NuttX task with VFS group
persistent_task_takeover.container_limit: All code, glyphs and literals must fit this exclusive function. Factory faclvgl command also enters replacement program; original factory test GUI behavior is replaced. Factory/provision data unchanged by this entry change.

cold_driver_initialization.geometry_transposition: 0x383df804..838 swaps initial x/y metadata320x480 into logical480x320, stride1920, virtual480x320
cold_driver_initialization.upper_registration: 0x380065fc getdriver;0x38006616 getvideoinfo;0x38006632 getplaneinfo;0x380066a6 register_driver;0x380066e4 task_spawn NSH happens afterwards
cold_driver_initialization.rcS_order: showlogo and panel_fb_switch run before vapp. Replaced vapp should not call LCD init again; validate open/query results and fail closed instead.

ioctl.signature: int ioctl(int fd, int cmd, uintptr_t arg)
ioctl.PAN: 0x2816; 28-byte buffer with owned source pointer at byte24
ioctl.2817: Clears upper byte+9 and returns0; this firmware does not implement blocking waitvsync at this number
ioctl.error: -1 + errno, lower negative return is translated

file_read.signature: ssize_t file_read(struct file *file, void *buf, size_t len)
file_read.error: negative errno directly; no POSIX -1 translation at this layer

private_plane_28_bytes.byte24: u32 vendor source pointer for PAN; not assumed standard yoffset; overwrite with owned malloc614400 pointer

videoinfo_8_bytes.limitation: Do not transplant current public NuttX structure layout without this firmware-specific audit.

owned_rendering.lifetime: Canvas remains owned and allocated for infinite counter task. PAN copies source into driver-owned staging synchronously before return; queue records also retain original source pointer, so do not free while queued.
owned_rendering.queue_full: Actual ARM MVN r0,#0 returns-1, not-EAGAIN. POSIX ioctl can report errno1. Use bounded scheduled delay/retry of negative PAN results rather than EAGAIN-only.
owned_rendering.source_exception: 0xffffffff invokes relocation path copying/freing original fbmem and switches50000000. Do not use this value for normal owned rendering.
owned_rendering.no_new_threads_required: Replacing builtin main supplies a valid normal task context; no debugger-context OS invocation or pthread bootstrap required.

scheduler_delay.request_16_bytes: offset0 sec int64; offset8 nsec int32; offset12 padding
scheduler_delay.evidence: NSH usleep38022870 builds this exact64bitseconds+32bitnsec structure and BL38042130 at380228ce. Native helper validates nsec<=999999999 at3804213e.
scheduler_delay.semantics: Normal scheduled sleep, preserving touch worker and display IRQ operation.

touch_loop.read: fs_getfilep once; file_read(file, sample32,32) blocks on subscriber semaphore while empty
touch_loop.counting: Increment only when DOWN/MOVE set and pressed latch was0; setpressed1. UP clears latch. Require sample size32 before reading flags. Coordinates not needed to count touches.
touch_loop.failure: Do not spin on shortread/negative; return/close or sleep/retry within audited behavior.
touch_loop.no_host_dependency: Task blocks/wakes through original NuttX input driver; no debugger polling or core halt required.

limits: Static proof is for original1.50.10 binary; cold firmware replacement still requires root hardware validation and updated NOR allowlist/whole-sector backups.
No hardware native API invocation or counter code execution performed by this audit.
Additional rcS tasks are retained; only original vapp GUI launch is replaced. Factory GUI command also uses replacement container.
